categories.name: Business operations
categories.boundary: Tools for running an organization, its projects, staff, customers, documents, compliance, and workplace/customer operational communication; excludes selling, recruiting, and finance-specific money flows.
categories.rationale: The source category names an organizational operations workflow.

categories.name: Developer tools
categories.boundary: Products whose user workflow is building, testing, deploying, or operating software; excludes generic AI and products merely built with a technology.
categories.rationale: The source category explicitly names a software development or infrastructure workflow.

categories.name: Design and creative
categories.boundary: Visual and audio creative production, including design, prototyping, graphics, photography, video, and music creation; excludes entertainment consumption.
categories.rationale: The source category names a creative production workflow or asset.

categories.name: Education and learning
categories.boundary: Learning, teaching, language study, and educational resources; excludes recruiting or on-the-job operations.
categories.rationale: The source category names learning or educational content.

categories.name: Finance
categories.boundary: Money management, payments, accounting, investing, banking, insurance, crypto finance, and finance-specific money flows; excludes sales analytics and general staff/workflow operations.
categories.rationale: The source category names a financial product or workflow.

categories.name: Health and wellness
categories.boundary: Physical and mental health, medical care, fitness, sleep, nutrition, and family care; excludes general productivity tracking.
categories.rationale: The source category names a health, care, or fitness purpose.

categories.name: Marketing and sales
categories.boundary: Acquisition, advertising, SEO, marketing content and automation, sales operations, and acquisition-specific measurement; excludes social interaction for its own sake.
categories.rationale: The source category names customer acquisition, promotion, or sales.

categories.name: Media and entertainment
categories.boundary: Games, music, video, news, podcasts, publishing and entertainment consumption; excludes media-production utilities.
categories.rationale: The source category names published media or entertainment consumption.

categories.name: Personal productivity
categories.boundary: Individual writing, planning, notes, time, calendars, documents, and file organization; excludes team operations.
categories.rationale: The source category names an individual information or task workflow.

categories.name: Security and privacy
categories.boundary: Security controls, authentication, privacy protection, and safety; excludes generic browsers or extensions.
categories.rationale: The source category names a security, identity, or privacy protection purpose.

categories.name: Shopping and commerce
categories.boundary: Retail buying, ecommerce storefronts, product marketplaces, and merchandising; excludes financial exchanges or job boards.
categories.rationale: The source category names retail shopping or a commerce storefront.

categories.name: Social and community
categories.boundary: General interpersonal communication, social networks, dating, and peer communities; excludes workplace/customer operations and marketing-channel tools.
categories.rationale: The source category names people interacting with one another.

categories.name: Travel and local
categories.boundary: Trip planning, transport, maps, accommodation and outdoor travel; excludes insurance products.
categories.rationale: The source category names travel, navigation, or accommodation.

categories.name: Work and careers
categories.boundary: Finding work, hiring, resumes, recruiting and workforce training; excludes general project management.
categories.rationale: The source category names employment, recruitment, or career progression.

categories.name: Data and analytics
categories.boundary: General-purpose data analysis, business intelligence, visualization, research, and measurement; excludes acquisition-specific analytics and ad-campaign measurement.
categories.rationale: The source category names a measurement or data-analysis workflow.

categories.name: Home and lifestyle
categories.boundary: Products for living in, caring for, planning, or improving a home, plus food and family lifestyle; excludes property finance, real estate lead generation, property-business operations, and retail storefronts.
categories.rationale: The source category names a home, food, or lifestyle purpose.
